overview: Sixteen more animals can be befriended, and will follow, wait and fight alongside you the way only a wolf could before.

1.1.0: A whistle reaches every companion you have, asleep in an unloaded chunk or in another dimension.
Ones already at your heel stay put, and anything on a lead or being ridden is left alone.
Every companion on one page, with how far off each one is and a button to let it go.
/companions release frees the one you are standing next to.
Feeding a hurt companion the food that won it over mends it.
An advancement for the day eight of them are still behind you.
1.0.0: Crouch and offer an animal what it likes, berries to a fox, bamboo to a panda, wheat to a cow.
It follows, waits where you put it, wears armour, and comes through a portal at your heels.
Pet any animal and watch it happen.
A companion told to stay potters about the spot rather than standing on one block.
